title: Skill
description: Validates a skill definition object. Skills describe discrete capabilities that agents or providers can expose, including optional typed input/output contracts.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this contract. Always 1 for this version of the spec.

id.description: Skill identifier in kebab-case. Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the skill does.

input_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema object describing the expected input for this skill.

output_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema object describing the expected output of this skill.

tags.description: Optional list of string tags for categorizing or filtering skills.
